description: Two-vehicle collision at intersection of Elm Street and Main Avenue. Policyholder's vehicle (2024 Honda Accord) struck by third-party vehicle running red light.
investigationNotes: Police report filed - Case #2026-PD-5567. Confirms third party ran red light.
Witness statement from pedestrian corroborates policyholder's account.
Vehicle damage assessment: front-end collision damage, estimated repair $12,400.
Medical bills submitted: ER visit $3,200, follow-up orthopedic $850.
Third party's insurer (State Farm) contacted for subrogation.

settlement.notes: Awaiting final medical bills before settlement calculation. Subrogation claim filed against third party.

timeline.event: Date of loss - vehicle collision reported
Claim assigned to adjuster J. Thompson
Subrogation demand sent to third party insurer

description: Water damage from burst pipe in upstairs bathroom. Affected master bedroom ceiling, walls, and hardwood flooring on first floor.
investigationNotes: Plumber report confirms burst pipe due to corrosion - not negligence.
Mold inspection completed - no hazardous mold detected.
Contractor estimate for repairs: $28,750 including flooring, drywall, and painting.
Personal property damage: $4,200 (furniture and electronics).
Temporary housing approved for 2 weeks during major repairs.

settlement.notes: Settlement approved: $28,750 (repairs) + $4,200 (personal property) - $1,000 (deductible) = $31,950. Temporary housing costs covered separately under loss of use.

timeline.event: Claim assigned to adjuster M. Rodriguez

description: Policyholder reports vehicle stolen from shopping center parking lot. 2025 BMW X5 valued at $65,000.
investigationNotes: Police report filed for vehicle theft - Case #2026-PD-7823.
SIU flagged: Policy taken out only 4 months before loss.
Policyholder has two prior theft claims in last 5 years with different insurers.
Shopping center security footage requested - footage shows vehicle leaving at 2:15 AM, inconsistent with reported timeline.
GPS data from vehicle's built-in system shows vehicle was driven to a location 50 miles away, not stolen from parking lot.
Financial records show policyholder has significant outstanding debts.

settlement.notes: Claim suspended pending SIU investigation. Multiple fraud indicators identified.

timeline.event: Claim assigned to adjuster K. Patel
SIU referral based on claim history flags
Claim escalated to fraud investigation unit

description: Slip and fall incident at policyholder's commercial property. Visitor sustained broken wrist and knee injury on wet floor without warning signs.
investigationNotes: Incident occurred in main lobby area during business hours.
Floor had been mopped 30 minutes prior - no wet floor signs placed.
Security footage confirms lack of warning signs.
Injured party (Angela Torres) treated at ER - broken right wrist, Grade 2 knee sprain.
Policyholder acknowledges maintenance staff did not place signs.
Liability appears clear - policyholder negligence in premises maintenance.

settlement.notes: Settled with injured party for $45,000 including medical expenses ($12,000), lost wages ($8,000), and pain/suffering ($25,000). Policyholder responsible for $2,500 deductible.

timeline.event: Slip and fall incident in lobby
Claim assigned to adjuster L. Washington

description: Severe hailstorm caused extensive damage to roof, siding, and detached garage. Multiple neighbors also affected.
investigationNotes: Catastrophe event CAT-2026-TX-05 declared for region.
Initial aerial inspection shows significant roof damage.
Ground inspection confirms: 40+ shingle impacts, 3 areas of exposed decking.
Siding damage on north and west faces.
Detached garage roof requires full replacement.
No interior water damage reported yet - temporary tarp installed.

settlement.notes: Estimates being compiled. Roof replacement estimate: $18,500. Siding repair: $7,200. Garage roof: $5,800. Total before deductible: $31,500.

timeline.event: Claim filed via mobile app with photos
